g.text: AA06 - Invite, Persist and Replace Activation Invitation
enter name, email, role, activation method
The new account has no local credential.
[email is not associated with an account]
create inactive account with CUSTOMER + requested role
save PENDING(token hash, method, recipient, expiry, tx)
No activation invitation is issued for an active account.
Preserve the existing method. If a legacy invitation's
method is unknown, require an explicit selected method.
[a first or replacement invitation was issued]
The account remains inactive. A retry replaces the pending
invitation and preserves its activation method.
withTransaction(create inactive account + CUSTOMER + LOCAL invitation)
send LOCAL activation email after commit
AA07 reads activation_method from the invitation and owns invitation
inspection, local/external activation, identity validation and consumption.
